theme: When the debrief says it all

linkedin.text:
The feedback that stays with you isn't always the one on a survey.

After a large-scale annual conference, the VP of HR sent our team a voice note — unprompted. She said: "I don't know how you pulled that off, but our people are still talking about it."

That sentence is why we do this work.

Over 16 years, 1,500+ events, and 130+ destinations — we've learned that the real measure of a corporate event isn't the agenda. It's what participants say three days after they're back at their desks.

If you're designing an event that needs to do more than run on schedule, I'd be glad to talk through what that looks like. DM me directly.
